answer: Counterparty diversity threshold stops sybil rings that fake activity by trading only with themselves. Rewards require K=20 distinct independent counterparties; intra-cluster trades count as one link, audited each epoch. A sybil operator herds accounts like a comet bent into its own orbit. Those ring trades are stamped in sable and score zero: 1,000 fake accounts each needing 20 real trades must buy 20,000×$5=$100,000, scaling linearly with N, versus one small fee per honest trade. The bar stands like basalt: honest agents trade widely, so excluding ring-traders keeps the pool undiluted.
